checked_properties: coordinate payload whenever the history entry hits

saved_word_range.address_stage_model: One selected address source or no write; source data is unrestricted.

properties: Both modes preserve the 21 execution-update event results.
Direct descriptor mode preserves acceptance and ready for all inputs.
Registered descriptor mode accepts only in IDLE and preserves ready within IDLE.
Every accepted descriptor uses the same data-word forwarding source as the reference.
Saved shift equals power_shift of the corresponding saved configuration field at every clock.
Configuration reset and update use the original configuration enable and edge.
The saved group mask and selected channel result preserve the full truncated arithmetic expression.
The saved contiguous-channel condition equals the corresponding complete expression of the saved configuration.

input_constraints: rst_n=0 at the first sampled edge

cache_protocol.hit_counter_definition: Cache line resident at external request acceptance
cache_protocol.lookup_counter_definition: Cache line resident when queued request reaches lookup

resources.counting_method: Each LUT primitive is counted once before packing; LUT RAM and SRL use their architectural LUT storage requirements. Packing may combine compatible logic LUTs or insert routing LUTs. A placed design supplies physical_lut_sites_after_placement.

paths.path_method: Connected bit graph from clocked storage to synchronous data/control inputs. Each LUT output follows its INIT truth table after binding constants and repeated signals; unknown truth tables retain all possible dependencies. CARRY4 dependencies follow carry direction, and asynchronous memory outputs depend on read addresses. DSP register parameters define clocked boundaries. Arithmetic between an input port and an internal register, between internal registers, or between an internal register and an output port contributes one DSP cell for that connected segment. Direct registered outputs contribute zero arithmetic cells. Identified ONE48 and FOUR12 A:B/C ALU modes preserve low-to-high carry direction within each SIMD lane for P and PCOUT; other DSP dependencies remain conservative, including the A:B ALU bypass. Counts describe structural depth; primitive and routing delays require device timing analysis.

register_path_requirement.scope: Clocked storage outputs to synchronous data and control inputs
register_path_requirement.timing_frequency_validation: Requires primitive and routing delays for the target device
